subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI client display-name override, and should that surface be CLI-only, persisted config-backed, or auto-derived?
rationale: The Gateway already accepts `clientDisplayName`, but choosing a public identity surface and whether to derive local machine/workspace names has product and privacy implications that automation should not decide.

options.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keep the existing default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

options.title: Add Persisted TUI Config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema, docs, and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI label until a broader identity and privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keep the existing default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Gateway TUI implementation and current unresolved public CLI/product choice most clearly route through this history.
